claims: Carlos Boozer has twin sons, Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are 2025-26 freshmen for the Duke Blue Devils.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer previously starred at Christopher Columbus High School in Miami, Florida.
Cameron Boozer was named the 2023 Gatorade National Boys Basketball Player of the Year.
Cameron Boozer averages over 20 points as a freshman at Duke in 2025-26.
Cameron Boozer averages 10 rebounds as a freshman at Duke in 2025-26.
Carlos Boozer compared Cameron Boozer's high-IQ playing style to a modern-day Tim Duncan.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard.
Cayden Boozer played alongside his brother to win four straight state championships at Columbus High School.
Cayden Boozer played alongside his brother to win a national title at Columbus High School.
Cayden Boozer is now starting for Duke.
Carlos Boozer expressed it is a "dream come true" to see both of his sons playing for his alma mater Duke.
Carlos Boozer played for Duke before his NBA career.
Carlos Boozer played 14 seasons in the NBA.
